<?php
/**
 * Petshop_Pet_Drafts — serveriniai anoniminės anketos draftai.
 *
 * KAM: iki S328 anoniminis draftas gyveno TIK localStorage. Zmogus uzpildydavo
 * anketa telefono narsykleje, atsidarydavo magic link Gmail programeles
 * imontuotoje narsykleje (kitas localStorage) ir rasdavo TUSCIA profili.
 * Duomenys dingdavo po to, kai jis jau atliko visa darba.
 * Serverinis draftas tai uzdaro: localStorage lieka TIK kaip UX cache,
 * tiesos saltinis yra si lentele.
 *
 * SPRENDIMAI (Raimis, 2026-07-31):
 *  - galiojimas 14 dienu; naujo magic link prasymas galiojimo NEPRATESIA;
 *  - el. pasto lentele NELAIKO — tik HMAC hash su ATSKIRU stabiliu raktu
 *    (ne token'u raktas, nerotuojamas kartu su jais);
 *  - claim per tarpine busena active -> claiming -> claimed;
 *  - po sekmes payload isvalomas, lieka tik claimed_* ir email_hash.
 *
 * MANO PRIELAIDOS (zymiu atvirai, grazinamos jei Raimis nesutiks):
 *  1. STALE_CLAIM_SECONDS = 900. Be sios taisykles nulužes procesas paliktu
 *     drafta amzinai busenoje 'claiming' ir zmogus nebeatgautu jo NIEKADA.
 *  2. Augintinio irase reikalingas UNIQUE indeksas ant source_draft_id —
 *     be UNIQUE jis leidzia tik RASTI dublikata po fakto, o ne UZKIRSTI keliui.
 *     Indeksas kuriamas atskirai (ps_pets migracija), ne siame faile.
 *
 * @package petshop-core
 * @since 0.24.2 (S328); claim_attempt_id + ps_pets migracija 2026-07-31
 */

if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
	exit;
}

class Petshop_Pet_Drafts {

	const DB_VERSION = '1.1.0';
	const OPT_DB_VER = 'petshop_pet_drafts_db_version';

	/** Atskiras HMAC raktas. NEROTUOJAMAS kartu su token'u raktais. */
	const OPT_HASH_KEY = 'petshop_pet_draft_hash_key';

	/** Galiojimas dienomis (Raimis: 14, ne 30). */
	const TTL_DAYS = 14;

	/** Po kiek sekundziu 'claiming' laikomas pakibusiu ir gali buti perimtas.
	 *  Sutampa su magic-link token'o TTL. VIENA vieta, ne isbarstytas skaicius. */
	private const CLAIM_STALE_SECONDS = 15 * MINUTE_IN_SECONDS;

	/** Payload schemos versija — kad veliau galetume migruoti senus draftus. */
	const PAYLOAD_VERSION = 1;

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Lentele                                                          */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	public static function table() {
		global $wpdb;
		return $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_pet_profile_drafts';
	}

	public static function install() {
		global $wpdb;
		require_once ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php';
		$t       = self::table();
		$charset = $wpdb->get_charset_collate();

		$sql = "CREATE TABLE $t (
			id BIGINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
			draft_id CHAR(36) NOT NULL,
			email_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
			payload_json LONGTEXT NULL,
			payload_version SMALLINT UNSIGNED NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
			status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
			created_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
			updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
			expires_at DATETIME NOT NULL,
			claim_started_at DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			claim_attempt_id CHAR(36) NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			claimed_at DATETIME NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			claimed_user_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			claimed_pet_id BIGINT UNSIGNED NULL DEFAULT NULL,
			PRIMARY KEY (id),
			UNIQUE KEY draft_id (draft_id),
			KEY status_expires (status, expires_at),
			KEY email_hash_idx (email_hash),
			KEY claimed_user (claimed_user_id),
			KEY claimed_pet (claimed_pet_id)
		) $charset;";

		dbDelta( $sql );
		self::ensure_pets_column();
		update_option( self::OPT_DB_VER, self::DB_VERSION );
	}

	/**
	 * ps_pets.source_draft_id + UNIQUE.
	 *
	 * UNIQUE yra ESME, ne puosmena: be jo du procesai galetu sukurti du
	 * augintinius tam paciam draftui, ir tik MES tai pastebetume — arba ne.
	 * Su UNIQUE antras INSERT lužta DB lygiu, o duplicate-key traktuojamas
	 * kaip IDEMPOTENTISKA SEKME (augintinis jau sukurtas, procesas nulužo
	 * pries complete_claim) — surandam esama irasa ir uzbaigiam drafta.
	 *
	 * MySQL leidzia kelias NULL reiksmes UNIQUE indekse, tad esami 65 irasai
	 * ir visi prisijungusio vartotojo kelio augintiniai NEPALIECIAMI.
	 *
	 * PASTABA: ps_pets schema priklauso Petshop_Pet_Profile. Migracija cia,
	 * kad nereiktu perrasineti 38 KB failo del vieno stulpelio. Perkelti i
	 * savininka, kai class-pet-profile.php bus liecamas del kitu priezasciu.
	 */
	private static function ensure_pets_column() {
		global $wpdb;
		$pets = $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_pets';

		$has_col = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.COLUMNS
			  WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = %s
			    AND COLUMN_NAME = 'source_draft_id'", $pets ) );
		if ( ! (int) $has_col ) {
			$wpdb->query( "ALTER TABLE `$pets` ADD COLUMN source_draft_id CHAR(36) NULL DEFAULT NULL" );
		}

		$has_idx = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare(
			"SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.STATISTICS
			  WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME = %s
			    AND INDEX_NAME = 'uniq_source_draft'", $pets ) );
		if ( ! (int) $has_idx ) {
			$wpdb->query( "ALTER TABLE `$pets` ADD UNIQUE KEY uniq_source_draft (source_draft_id)" );
		}
	}

	public static function maybe_install() {
		if ( get_option( self::OPT_DB_VER ) !== self::DB_VERSION ) {
			self::install();
		}
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* El. pasto HMAC                                                   */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * Stabilus raktas. Sukuriamas VIENA karta ir daugiau neliecamas —
	 * pasikeites raktas paverstu visus gyvus draftus nepasiekiamais.
	 */
	private static function hash_key() {
		$key = get_option( self::OPT_HASH_KEY );
		if ( ! $key ) {
			$key = wp_generate_password( 64, true, true );
			// autoload=no: raktas reikalingas tik draftu keliuose.
			add_option( self::OPT_HASH_KEY, $key, '', 'no' );
			$key = get_option( self::OPT_HASH_KEY );
		}
		return (string) $key;
	}

	/**
	 * Normalizacija PRIVALO buti identiska visose trijose vietose
	 * (drafto kurimas, token'o subject_email, prisijungusio vartotojo email),
	 * kitaip palyginimas tyliai neduos sutapimo.
	 */
	public static function email_hash( $email ) {
		$norm = strtolower( trim( (string) $email ) );
		if ( '' === $norm ) {
			return '';
		}
		return hash_hmac( 'sha256', $norm, self::hash_key() );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Kurimas                                                          */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * @return string|WP_Error draft_id
	 */
	public static function create( $email, array $payload ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$hash = self::email_hash( $email );
		if ( '' === $hash ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'ps_draft_email', 'Netinkamas el. pastas.' );
		}

		$now      = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		$expires  = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() + self::TTL_DAYS * DAY_IN_SECONDS );
		$draft_id = wp_generate_uuid4();

		$ok = $wpdb->insert(
			self::table(),
			array(
				'draft_id'        => $draft_id,
				'email_hash'      => $hash,
				'payload_json'    => wp_json_encode( $payload, JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE ),
				'payload_version' => self::PAYLOAD_VERSION,
				'status'          => 'active',
				'created_at'      => $now,
				'updated_at'      => $now,
				'expires_at'      => $expires,
			),
			array( '%s', '%s', '%s', '%d', '%s', '%s', '%s', '%s' )
		);

		if ( ! $ok ) {
			return new WP_Error( 'ps_draft_insert', 'Nepavyko issaugoti anketos.' );
		}
		return $draft_id;
	}

	public static function get( $draft_id ) {
		global $wpdb;
		return $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare(
			'SELECT * FROM ' . self::table() . ' WHERE draft_id = %s',
			(string) $draft_id
		) );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Claim: active -> claiming -> claimed                             */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * ZINGSNIS 1. Atominis pasiemimas. VIENAS UPDATE, be SELECT pries ji —
	 * kitaip du tab'ai spetu abu perskaityti 'active' ir sukurti DU augintinius.
	 *
	 * Perimam ir pakibusi 'claiming' (zr. STALE_CLAIM_SECONDS).
	 *
	 * Grazina claim_attempt_id — SAVININKO zyme. Be jos senas pakibes procesas,
	 * "atsibudes" jau po to, kai claim'a perieme kitas, galetu uzbaigti arba
	 * atsaukti SVETIMA bandyma. Vien status='claiming' to neatskiria.
	 *
	 * @return array {ok, reason, row, attempt_id}
	 */
	public static function begin_claim( $draft_id, $user_id, $email ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$draft_id = (string) $draft_id;
		$row      = self::get( $draft_id );

		if ( ! $row ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'reason' => 'not_found', 'row' => null, 'attempt_id' => '' );
		}
		// Jau perkeltas — NE klaida. Kartotinis magic link panaudojimas
		// turi parodyti TA PATI profili, o ne sukurti nauja.
		if ( 'claimed' === $row->status ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'reason' => 'already_claimed', 'row' => $row, 'attempt_id' => '' );
		}
		if ( strtotime( $row->expires_at ) < time() ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'reason' => 'expired', 'row' => $row, 'attempt_id' => '' );
		}
		// SVETIMAS DRAFTAS. Prisijungusio vartotojo pastas privalo sutapti.
		if ( ! hash_equals( (string) $row->email_hash, self::email_hash( $email ) ) ) {
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'reason' => 'email_mismatch', 'row' => $row, 'attempt_id' => '' );
		}

		$now     = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		$stale   = gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - self::CLAIM_STALE_SECONDS );
		$attempt = wp_generate_uuid4();

		$affected = $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
			'UPDATE ' . self::table() . "
			    SET status = 'claiming', claim_started_at = %s,
			        claim_attempt_id = %s, updated_at = %s
			  WHERE draft_id = %s
			    AND expires_at > %s
			    AND ( status = 'active'
			          OR ( status = 'claiming' AND claim_started_at < %s ) )",
			$now, $attempt, $now, $draft_id, $now, $stale
		) );

		if ( 1 !== (int) $affected ) {
			// Kitas procesas spejo pirmas — NEKURIAM augintinio.
			return array( 'ok' => false, 'reason' => 'race_lost', 'row' => self::get( $draft_id ), 'attempt_id' => '' );
		}
		return array( 'ok' => true, 'reason' => '', 'row' => self::get( $draft_id ), 'attempt_id' => $attempt );
	}

	/**
	 * ZINGSNIS 3. Tik PO to, kai augintinis realiai sukurtas.
	 * Payload isvalomas — augintinio duomenys nebeguli dviejose vietose.
	 */
	public static function complete_claim( $draft_id, $attempt_id, $user_id, $pet_id ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$now = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		return (int) $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
			'UPDATE ' . self::table() . "
			    SET status = 'claimed', payload_json = NULL,
			        claimed_at = %s, claimed_user_id = %d, claimed_pet_id = %d, updated_at = %s
			  WHERE draft_id = %s AND status = 'claiming' AND claim_attempt_id = %s",
			$now, (int) $user_id, (int) $pet_id, $now, (string) $draft_id, (string) $attempt_id
		) );
	}

	/**
	 * ZINGSNIS 4. Augintinio sukurti nepavyko — draftas GRAZINAMAS i apyvarta.
	 * Be sito zmogus prarastu anketa del musu klaidos.
	 */
	public static function abort_claim( $draft_id, $attempt_id ) {
		global $wpdb;
		$now = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		return (int) $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
			'UPDATE ' . self::table() . "
			    SET status = 'active', claim_started_at = NULL,
			        claim_attempt_id = NULL, updated_at = %s
			  WHERE draft_id = %s AND status = 'claiming' AND claim_attempt_id = %s",
			$now, (string) $draft_id, (string) $attempt_id
		) );
	}

	/**
	 * Crash recovery: augintinis jau sukurtas, bet procesas nulužo pries
	 * complete_claim. Naudojama gavus duplicate-key — tada tai ne klaida.
	 */
	public static function find_pet_by_draft( $draft_id ) {
		global $wpdb;
		return (int) $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare(
			'SELECT id FROM ' . $wpdb->prefix . 'ps_pets WHERE source_draft_id = %s',
			(string) $draft_id
		) );
	}

	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
	/* Retencija                                                        */
	/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

	/**
	 * Kasdienis valymas. Trinam TIK nepanaudotus pasibaigusius draftus.
	 * 'claimed' eilutes lieka — jose PII nebera (payload NULL), o
	 * email_hash + claimed_pet_id reikalingi idempotencijai.
	 *
	 * @return int istrintu eiluciu
	 */
	public static function cleanup_expired() {
		global $wpdb;
		$now = current_time( 'mysql', true );
		return (int) $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare(
			'DELETE FROM ' . self::table() . "
			  WHERE status <> 'claimed' AND expires_at < %s",
			$now
		) );
	}

	public static function stats() {
		global $wpdb;
		return $wpdb->get_results(
			'SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS c FROM ' . self::table() . ' GROUP BY status',
			ARRAY_A
		);
	}
}
